name: ConvertyBot
author: 2wstechnologies

sections.description:
ConvertyBot is an advanced AI-powered chatbot designed specifically for WooCommerce stores. It acts as a virtual sales assistant, helping your customers find the perfect products, answering their questions, and providing personalized recommendations based on their browsing behavior and preferences.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Conversations – Natural language processing for human-like interactions
  • Product Recommendations – Smart suggestions based on customer preferences and behavior
  • Dynamic Coupon Generation – Create personalized discount codes to incentivize purchases
  • Visitor Tracking – Understand customer journeys and behavior patterns
  • Analytics Dashboard – Comprehensive insights into chatbot performance and conversions
  • Customizable Appearance – Match your store’s branding with custom colors and messages
  • Multi-language Support – Communicate with customers in their preferred language
  • GDPR Compliant – Built-in consent management for privacy compliance

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Complete the setup wizard to configure your AI assistant
  3. Customize the chatbot appearance and welcome messages
  4. Set up coupon rules for automated discount generation
  5. Monitor performance through the analytics dashboard

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher

External Service

This plugin connects to the ConvertyBot API service (https://convertybot.com) to provide AI-powered chat functionality. When using this plugin:

  • Product catalog data is securely transmitted to the ConvertyBot servers for AI processing
  • Chat conversations are processed through the ConvertyBot AI service
  • Analytics data is stored on ConvertyBot servers to provide dashboard insights

By using this plugin, you agree to:
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy

No personal data is collected without user consent. The plugin includes a GDPR-compliant consent banner that must be accepted before any tracking begins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the convertybot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘AI Chatbot’ in your admin menu to start the setup wizard
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to configure your AI assistant
  5. Customize the appearance and behavior settings as needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, ConvertyBot is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Is there a free version?

Yes, ConvertyBot offers a free trial period and a free tier with limited conversations per month.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes, you can customize colors, welcome messages, chatbot name, and more through the Configuration page.

Is customer data secure?

Yes, we follow WordPress security best practices and GDPR guidelines. All data is encrypted and stored securely.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, ConvertyBot is compatible with popular page builders like Elementor, Divi, and WPBakery.
